scenes.title: Neon Grow Room
scenes.description: A futuristic indoor garden packed with lights, ducts, pots, leaves, and geometric wall panels.
prompts: Give every plant a different color family, then make the room itself surprisingly calm.
Use only four palette colors and make the lighting feel louder than the plants.
Build a warm-to-cool gradient from the left side of the room to the right.

scenes.title: Cloud Garden
scenes.description: A fantasy garden floating above soft hills with oversized leaves, flowers, clouds, and a winding path.
prompts: Color the garden like sunrise reached the ground before it reached the clouds.
Make the giant leaves opposites: one loud, one quiet.
Use the path as the visual anchor and let every other region orbit around it.

scenes.title: Trichome Observatory
scenes.description: A glass observatory where giant trichome forms rise around a telescope, moon, planet, and control deck.
prompts: Use the trichomes as three different light sources and color the room around them.
Make the observatory feel like a midnight postcard with one bright accent color.
Treat the moon and planet as rivals: give each its own palette family.

scenes.title: Seed City
scenes.description: A playful skyline of seed-shaped towers, a greenhouse, tram line, rooftop garden, and curved city road.
prompts: Make each tower belong to a different neighborhood while keeping one shared city color.
Color the road and tram first, then use them to decide every building color.
Create a nighttime city without using the darkest palette color on the sky.
